{{Quote|The laws of Trupellian probability ''alone'' point to the impossibility of his infamously long-lived winning streak in the Rafa system.|A minion of Quaffug the Hutt, on Lando Calrissian|<ref name="BH">''[[The Bounty Hunters: Scoundrel's Wages]]''</ref>}}
'''Trupellian probability''' was a discipline that dealt with the probability of certain events.<ref name="BH" /> It originated in the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies']] [[Trupellia system/Legends|Trupellia system]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref><ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=Trupellian probability|system=[[Trupellia system/Legends|Trupellia system]]|legends=1}}</ref>

While on a diplomatic [[Mission to Blimph 3|mission]] to the [[Tertiary Moon of Blimph|third moon of Blimph]] due to its strategic importance to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] was captured by [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] working for [[Quaffug]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]], who held a grudge against Calrissian after the [[Human/Legends|Human]] had won in [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]] years earlier in the [[Rafa system/Legends|Rafa system]]. Reinforced by the laws of Trupellian probability, Quaffug believed this was due to cheating and sentenced Calrissian to take part in a [[Duff-Jikab]]..<ref name="BH" />
